title: Japan's Nuclear Shift?
description: A breakdown of Japan's evolving security policy, the Three Non-Nuclear Principles, and the geopolitical fallout as Tokyo weighs emergency exceptions for US nuclear port calls.

seo.title: Is Japan Allowing US Nuke Ships Again?
seo.description: Japan’s decades-long Three Non-Nuclear Principles are facing a major test as Tokyo drafts an emergency exception to allow US nuclear-armed vessels in port during crises. With regional tensions rising and domestic debate intensifying, we break down what this loophole means for pacifism, extended deterrence, and Japan’s future security posture.
